{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjqe88AAAABYtojeQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3INzhCSoSA", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IN", "number": 37, "title": "Seed a lively fictional PC-VAN community on the first visit", "body": "## Problem

A new visitor opens PC-VAN and sees almost empty forums. At present, `src/forums.ts` falls back to three sparse, synthetic `DEMO` posts only when there is no locally stored SIG; the current Issue #35 resident bootstrap creates **two empty writable forums only after WebLLM download consent**, which hides the demo fallback and leaves a fresh world empty until local model inference succeeds. An empty forum makes the new ten-resident community feel abandoned.

A visitor should experience a conversation that was already underway **on the first page visit**, before downloading any model, creating a human member, or generating a post.

## Expected outcome

A truly new browser-local world is initialized with a coherent, **prewritten fictional community history**: approximately **25–35 original Japanese posts** across the existing MITI 資料室 (`MITI:9`) and DAISIZEN 自然の森／FREE (`DAISIZEN:1`), authored by the **existing ten AI resident identities**. Several short threads have genuine reply relationships; dates are distributed plausibly across the **7–14 days prior to the world's creation**, with some recent activity and quiet gaps. This gives visitors real posts to read immediately, and a foundation they can join or watch the AI residents continue.

The initial messages are **bundled, original static fixture content**, not the result of an initial LLM download or a fake live network. Later AI posts should naturally read and reply to this history. No app server or API key is required.

## Context

- `src/ai/personas.ts`: ten seeded fictional residents (stable IDs such as `fictional-ai:hoshimori`, `fictional-ai:kusabue` and `fictional-ai:hankote`) have occupations, interests and social affinities. Preserve IDs and profiles.
- `src/storage/repository.ts`: `readActivity` seeds resident settings/member rows; `bootstrapForums` currently creates **empty** MITI:9 and DAISIZEN:1 boards only when `state.bootstrap && state.consent`. Initialization must be decoupled from heavyweight AI download consent, and be atomic/idempotent.
- `src/forums.ts` and `data/pcvan/demo-posts.json`: old in-memory display-only fallback contains only three short demo posts with DEMO IDs. A newly initialized, stored world takes precedence over these. Avoid showing two conflicting sets or resurrecting demo data.
- `src/ai/activity.ts` and `src/ai/generation.ts`: recent-post, reply-target and memory selection currently recognize `local-human` or `local-ai:webllm:` origins. Seeded posts need a clearly distinct stored origin (e.g. `local-seed:fictional`) **and must be valid eligible context/reply targets** for future local AI activity without being mistaken for actually model-generated posts. Check all filters.
- `src/storage/schema.ts`: posts require stable IDs, same-forum reply references to **earlier post numbers**, unique numbering, valid member/board foreign keys and ISO timestamps. Keep current backup format compatible where possible.
- Evidence and authenticity matter: **do not use copyrighted historical posts, real PC-VAN users, historical IDs or falsely dated archived material**. Create period-inspired, clearly fictional text only. Preserve provenance in storage and Settings/About, without injecting disruptive `創作` disclaimers into every terminal post.
- User priority: **the first time they visit, it must already feel like ten regulars have been there chatting**, not an empty app waiting for them to click a model-load button.
- Follow [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/blob/main/AGENTS.md), the [Issue template](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/issue.md), and [development guidance](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md). Issue/PR/docs text in English; in-app fictional posts in Japanese.

### Starter-content direction

Write approximately 25–35 concise, **original** posts spread over 6–10 small threads, with coherent replies and more than one speaker in several threads. Use **all ten** established resident profiles, with a plausible imbalance in how often each writes. Topics should fit the existing two boards (old PCs, repair projects, stargazing, experiments; gardening, birds, outings, photography), and include modest everyday chit-chat, questions answered later, gentle humor and an open-ended thread that a real visitor can reply to. **Avoid obvious templated greetings repeated ten times**. Use plausible local-hour/weekday timing and non-uniform gaps.

Store a durable world-created-at timestamp or fixed initialization anchor on the first visit. Derive fictional post dates relative to that anchor **once**, not every reload, and do not present them as genuine 1996 posts. Author ID, reply chain, title/body and dates must remain internally consistent.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Add a small, reviewable UTF-8 fixture set with approximately 25–35 original Japanese seed posts over at least two existing boards and 6–10 related threads. All ten residents appear as authors, each with recognizable interests/voice; several threads contain two or more resident replies, with properly ordered same-forum `replyToPostId` links. The fixture contains **no archived copyrighted user posts** and no remote historical identities.
- [ ] On first launch with a truly pristine browser profile, initialize the ten residents and two local boards **with those posts immediately**, before any WebGPU/model download consent, user registration or human post. The first forum visit displays a populated list. Initialization is local, needs no network/model and doesn't block ordinary terminal navigation with GPU work.
- [ ] The initialization uses a **single idempotent transaction or equivalent safe commit**, producing unique board-local post numbers, stable IDs and valid foreign keys, with dates spread over the recent fictional past at realistic hours. Distinct original data provenance is saved and inspectable in Settings/About and JSON backup, but ordinary reading stays immersive.
- [ ] Refresh, reconnect, multiple simultaneous tabs and service-worker upgrades must **never duplicate or recreate seed posts**. A marker or world state distinguishes never-initialized from deliberately cleared/empty/imported worlds; no first-visit seed after an explicit JSON restore, including an empty import. Do not replace user posts or existing SIG/board customizations in an established profile.
- [ ] Preserve already-existing local users and backups without silently adding 30 posts. Provide an explicit **optional initialize/populate empty community** action in Settings for pre-feature profiles **only when safely applicable**, with a preview/confirmation; it must not overwrite existing posts, and repeating it must be harmless. Avoid intrusive prompts in ordinary terminal output.
- [ ] Treat seeded posts as legitimate local **fictional** conversation for browsing, human replies, AI reply selection, context and conversational continuity. Extend the filters in `src/ai/activity.ts` / `generation.ts` where needed, without reclassifying seeded content as WebLLM generation or creating incompatible history/reply references.
- [ ] Preserve the existing **ten-resident autonomous scheduler** and its explicit initial model-download permission. After consent, future generated posts can reply to eligible seeded threads and start fresh ones; no manual user post is needed. Existing global rate limits, bounded catch-up, cancellation and two-tab deduplication still apply.
- [ ] Replace or rationalize the old three-post DEMO fallback for newly seeded worlds so users see one consistent history. Existing backup compatibility, independent human/AI identities, unread/read markers, indexed posts and rollback on storage errors are preserved.
- [ ] Add tests with isolated fresh/existing/imported browser profiles and a fixed clock for first-visit visibility, dates/board distributions, 10 authors, multiple reply chains, transactional failure, reload/two-tab idempotency, post numbering, old-profile explicit opt-in, imported empty world, backup/restore, human reply and mocked later AI reply to seeded posts. No real GPU, model download or backend needed.
- [ ] Update README and local-AI documentation with bootstrap behavior, fictional content provenance, reset/population semantics and the clear distinction between seed posts and newly generated AI posts. Run repository build/`npm test` and document actual validation performed.

## Optional validation

Manual first-use experience review: visit the published app in a fresh profile and confirm it feels like a lived-in text community rather than ten canned greeting messages. This subjective review is optional, not a required pre-merge approval.

## Required post-merge verification

None required. Seed initialization and browser behavior can be validated against a production build before merge. GitHub Pages workflow status may be tracked separately; hosted publication is not a pre-merge gate.
